crossRefs.note: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
translations.bsb: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord that Elijah is here!’ He will kill me!”
translations.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
translations.asv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here; and he will slay me.
